entities.summary: Andrey Viktorovich Ashchev  is a Russian male volleyball player. He was part of the Russia men's national volleyball team at the 2014 FIVB Volleyball Men's World Championship in Poland. He played for Zenit Kazan. Andrey with national team winner of World league 2013 and Championship Europe 2013.
